evidence_excerpts: We have at least three good reasons for thinking that quantum computers have capabilities surpassing what classical computers can do.

The theoretical computer scientists have provided arguments, based on complexity theory, showing under reasonable assumptions that quantum states which are easy to prepare with a quantum computer have super-classical properties.
text: Quantum computers have credible grounds for super-classical power because of known quantum algorithms, complexity-theoretic sampling arguments, and the absence of efficient classical simulations of general quantum computation.
